big_case.notes: Substantial border-infrastructure, environmental and cultural stakes, with a nationally relevant distinction between constitutional claims and statutory interpretation under a jurisdiction-limiting waiver statute. The ruling is interim, not final approval of the projects or resolution of every constitutional challenge.

leakage.notes: The fully captured log places all 12 calls on October 29, before the November 9 outcome. It shows provisioned-input and statpack reads plus a rejected corpus query and a broad granted-applications query. Neither query targets this application's disposition. The candidate discloses that the recent-application results were unhelpful and makes no claim of knowing the outcome. No already-decided disposition appears in the staged prose or query record.

central_claims.basis: The staged November 9 disposition grants the stay pending a timely certiorari petition, with no summary reversal.
central_claims.claim: The Court will grant a stay rather than summarily reverse, leaving further review for the certiorari process.

central_claims.basis: The docket records the October 30 reply and November 9 referral and disposition.
central_claims.claim: The application will be referred to the full Court and resolved in roughly one to two weeks after the October 29 response, following a reply.

central_claims.basis: The per-curiam explanation expressly relies on section 102(c)(2)(A), Dalton and the statutory character of the major-questions canon.
central_claims.claim: If the Court addresses the legal ground, it will apply the jurisdictional bar and Dalton because a major-questions argument concerns statutory authority rather than a constitutional claim.

central_claims.basis: The explanation does not adjudicate the geographic statutory predicate. It credits border security, unrecoverable costs and Congress's preference for expeditious construction over the asserted harms.
central_claims.claim: The Court will likely not decide whether Big Bend is an area of high illegal entry, and governmental border-construction interests will outweigh the asserted environmental and recreational harms.

central_claims.basis: The staged writing and docket both state that Justice Jackson would deny the stay. No separate dissent is staged, and the forecast made written dissents only possibilities.
central_claims.claim: A grant will draw noted opposition from at least one of Sotomayor, Kagan and Jackson.
